description: Toolkit basic usage metadata; no prompts, reports, tool arguments or paths. Disable with RESEARCH_TOOLKIT_TELEMETRY=off. See docs/usage-data.md.

hooks.command: root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; case "$root" in /*|[a-zA-Z]:[\\/]*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$root/scripts/usage_host.py" ] || exit 0; py=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; exec "$py" -Es "$root/scripts/usage_host.py" --host auto
hooks.commandWindows: python -I -c "import os,runpy,sys; root=os.getenv('PLUGIN_ROOT') or os.getenv('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT') or os.getenv('CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT') or ''; path=os.path.join(root,'scripts','usage_host.py'); (os.path.isabs(root) and os.path.isfile(path)) or sys.exit(0); sys.path.insert(0,os.path.dirname(path)); runpy.run_path(path,run_name='__main__')" --host auto
